description: Simulates and executes a gasless, sponsored Web3 transaction on Base L2 (e.g. token swaps, transfers) against operator-allowlisted targets. Simulates before broadcasting: Tenderly when the operator has it enabled, otherwise an RPC gas estimate plus a USDC amount cap. Requires an API key. When the operator charges for execution, the first call returns the x402 USDC payment requirements; sign that EIP-3009 authorization locally (never send a private key) and call again with paymentSignature. Payment settles only after the target and simulation checks pass, and only for the exact price.

fromAddress.description: The Safe Smart Account address performing the action.

maxAllowedDrainUSD.description: Maximum allowable wallet drain in USD. Checked against Tenderly balance changes; an RPC-only simulation reports none.

paymentSignature.description: Base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: { signature, payload: { from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce } } for the EIP-3009 USDC TransferWithAuthorization in the payment requirements. Single-use and exact-price; signed by your own wallet.

sessionKeyId.description: Optional gateway-issued session key id to enforce spend/target caps.

targetAddress.description: Target contract or token recipient address.

valueWei.description: Native token value in Wei (defaults to '0').

name: execute_onchain_intent
